card: ROLE: supreme warrior and apex of the Metabaron lineage; absent from City Shaft for three months at the time of the framing narrative
ROLE: master of Tonto and Lothar; his bionic marks are the pivot on which Tonto's entire dynastic narration turns
TRAIT: bald and stern in bearing; visual identity defined by ornate sword and cybernetic armor
TRAIT: carries a bionic ear and lobe — his right ear and part of his right brain were destroyed by his own father as initiatory sacrifice
TRAIT: the mutilation is not an injury but a mark of succession: each generation of the lineage destroyed something in their heir before transferring the title
TRAIT: human flesh underlies the augmentations; cybernetics are the inscription of lineage on the body, not a replacement of humanity
RELATIONSHIP: tonto (Tonto): master; Tonto awaits his return in City Shaft and narrates the full Metabaron dynasty to explain why the master bears bionic marks
RELATIONSHIP: lothar (Lothar): master; Lothar waits alongside Tonto and his curiosity about the augmentations is the direct prompt for the narration
RELATIONSHIP: othon_von_salza (Othon Von Salza): great-great-grandson; the lineage Tonto narrates runs from Othon's founding of the cybernetic tradition to the Metabaron as its current endpoint
VOICE: not directly heard in this source record; presence is entirely refracted through Tonto's testimony and cover imagery
